summary: Iteration 2 (Fresh Start v2 connected system). Backend: 18/19 pytest tests pass (tests/test_freshstart_v2.py, isolated TEST_ user). Passing: async day plan in pantry_only mode (ready in about 30s); calendar/range days/meals/logs/totals and the 422 on a bad date; accept/decline/move/favorite/favorites; idempotent eat (same log_id, calories = per-serving x servings, a single log row); cook with partial pantry deductions (e.g. 'Eggs: 8 left', 'Cheddar cheese: 340 g block left', nothing wiped) and a 409 on a second cook; to-shopping and schedule copy; craving and ingredients generators plus the 422 when nothing is picked; manual meal (status manual, opens via GET /recipes/{id}); swap with feedback; no duplicate shopping names; item to-pantry and checked-to-pantry; share HTML, items and toggle; nutrition estimate (goldfish = '1 serving (30 g)', 30 g, 467 kcal/100g, unit_grams); rewards and the bad quest-claim error. FAILED: share revoke. DELETE /api/shopping/share returns 404 'Item not found' because DELETE /shopping/{item_id} is declared first and captures the request, so the link stays public. Frontend at 390x844 had no red screens. Working flows: demo login; home (logo, points pill -> rewards with 5 quests and 7 badges, next meal, 4 actions, macros); Plan Day/Week toggle, week strip prev/next, 4 sections with Add buttons; AI cards with accept/decline/move/swap (accepted cards drop accept/decline, manual cards show swap only); move sheet; AI plan sheet scope/mode, and a UI-driven day plan in pantry_plus mode (4 meals in about 24s plus a grocery summary); craving generator with 'Add context' -> recipe detail with have/buy and macros; favourite heart; eat stepper with 1.5 servings and 'Update what I ate' on re-tap (no duplicate); add to list; swap sheet; pantry 'Use in a meal' -> /cook-with?preselect with 1 selected -> recipe -> cook showing partial deductions; favourites add-to-day; manual entry; shopping store chips, running total, detail sheet (needed for, combined qty, missing/top-up, price comparison), bought->pantry, share sheet; food log estimate -> serving suggestion, 15 units, g/handful recalculation, saved. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch) and no SafeAreaView issues detected.

critical.issue: Route shadowed by @api.delete('/shopping/{item_id}') (server.py:672), which is declared before revoke_share (server.py:1418). Returns 404 'Item not found', so the share link is never revoked (verified: /api/share/{token}/items still 200 after revoke). Fix: move the /shopping/share routes above /shopping/{item_id}, or rename the path.

minor.issue: Items added from craving, cook-with, swap, schedule, manual and to-shopping get no 'prices' or 'product', so the price comparison and per-store totals are empty for them. Demo: 32/37 items have no prices and 5 have Walmart only, with stores Walmart/No Frills/Costco. TEST user: 10/14 unpriced.

Combined quantity double-counts. Demo 'Cheddar Cheese' = '500g + 115 g + 320g': 500g is already the plan's combined total, then per-meal amounts are appended. 'Bread' = '2 loaves + 1 loaf (675g)' while needed_for lists only 1 meal.

Output is pulled too hard toward the pantry: 'creamy chicken curry' -> 'Creamy Spinach Chicken Curry Pasta'; 'spicy tofu noodles' -> 'Spicy Tofu & Spinach Pasta'. The craving should take priority over the pantry context in the prompt.
float(res.get('serving_g')) and the other float() casts raise if the LLM returns a string like '30 g', giving a 502. Parse defensively.

ui_bugs.issue: onPress has no try/catch. The backend 404 throws an uncaught 'Item not found' (pageerror) and the link stays active.
Shows 'Nothing missing — you have it all.' when added=0 because the items were already on the list, even though the 'Need to buy' section has items. Misleading.

integration_issues.issue: Most items show no per-store prices (see recipe_to_shop). Store chip totals don't reflect every item.

issues: The floating 'Scan Food' FAB covers the quest card text ('Cook 3 …') at the initial scroll position.
The 'Starts Wed Nov 25 2026' date chip sits right against the bottom edge of the sheet and looks clipped at 390x844.

action_items: Fix route order: declare DELETE /shopping/share (and POST) before /shopping/{item_id}, and wrap the share-revoke onPress in try/catch with an error state.
Make recipe_to_shop/merge_shopping fill per-store prices (e.g. a batched AI price lookup for new items at the user's stores) so the price comparison and store totals cover every item.
Fix combined-quantity double counting when merging per-meal quantities into a plan item whose quantity is already a combined total.
Make the craving generator prompt put the craving first (use the pantry as optional), so 'noodles' doesn't become pasta.
Show 'Already on your list' rather than 'Nothing missing' when to-shopping adds 0 because the items were merged.
Defensive numeric parsing in estimate_food; split server.py into modules.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:672 vs 1418: route shadowing breaks share revoke.
recipe_to_shop builds items with no prices/product, so the price feature works only for plan-generated items.
estimate_food float() casts on LLM output can raise.
Home FAB overlaps content at rest; the list has bottom padding, so it's fine after scrolling.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work except share revoke)
